Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

As a member of Ramp's Fraud Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company and its customers against fraudulent activities. This position involves analyzing new account applications, monetary and non-monetary account activity to identify and mitigate risks associated with first-party and third-party fraud.

We are seeking a detail-oriented professional who is adept at applying fraud detection techniques and leveraging data sources and tools to develop logical courses of action. In addition to technical acumen, this role requires strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively cross-functionally and with customers, external financial institutions, and law enforcement agencies. Ideal candidates are self-starters who are energized by ambiguity and love creating clarity.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Analyze new account applications to detect potential fraud patterns, including identity theft, synthetic identities, and other high-risk behaviors.

 - Evaluate transactional activity, identifying anomalies and irregularities indicative of fraudulent behavior.

 - Thoroughly investigate alerts of first-party and third-party fraud, providing comprehensive documentation of findings.

 - Investigate and facilitate customer card disputes, ensuring cases are resolved accurately and within network timelines.

 - Use AI tools and automation to streamline investigations, and help develop and improve the processes and tooling behind them.

 - Collaborate with internal teams, such as Credit Risk, Compliance, and Customer Support, to ensure timely resolution of fraud-related issues.

 - Communicate directly with customers to verify account activity, resolve disputes, and gather necessary documentation during investigations.

 - Liaise with external stakeholders, including financial institutions and law enforcement, to support investigations and facilitate recovery efforts when necessary.

 - Stay updated on emerging fraud trends, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements to enhance fraud prevention and detection measures.

 - Perform root cause analyses, document control breakdowns, and work with the strategy and engineering teams to improve fraud controls.

 - Document procedures and proactively identify opportunities for operational process improvement.




WORK SCHEDULE REQUIREMENTS

Fraud doesn't operate on a standard 9-to-5 schedule, and neither does this role. Candidates must have the flexibility to work nights, weekends, and holidays as part of a rotating schedule to ensure 24/7 fraud monitoring and response. This is essential to maintaining Ramp’s commitment to protecting its customers and minimizing risk around the clock.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - Minimum 2 years of experience in fraud prevention or investigations

 - Experience within consumer/corporate/small business cards, payments, invoices, lending, or related industries

 - Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with NACHA rules and regulations

 - Experience with card network rules and regulations, including dispute and chargeback processes

 - Experience with funds recovery processes, including hold harmless letters and ACH recalls

 - Experience in high-growth startups

 - Experience integrating AI into your daily work

 - Knowledge of SQL or Python






BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp's Strategic Enterprise CSMs don't manage accounts — they transform how companies run their finances. This is a role for people who have been inside large organizations when change was hard, who speak the language of a CFO, and who already use AI the way surgeons use instruments: not occasionally, not as an experiment, but as the default way they work. You'll be embedded in Ramp's largest, most strategic enterprise accounts, responsible for driving genuine workflow transformation — not just onboarding completion.

What You'll Do

  • Lead enterprise customers through the full transformation journey — from implementation through agentic workflow adoption — with clear accountability for time-to-value and measurable business outcomes

  • Build and own the change management strategy for each account: map stakeholders, diagnose resistance, build internal coalitions, and drive adoption past the finish line

  • Quantify and communicate Ramp's impact in the language CFOs and Controllers care about — close cycle improvement, spend visibility, variance reduction, and ROI — not just product usage metrics

  • Run executive-level stakeholder management across multiple layers of a customer org, including C-suite relationships you own independently

  • Use AI tools daily to prepare for customer calls, build materials, synthesize data, identify account risk, and operate at a pace traditional methods can't match

  • Help customers understand and adopt Ramp's agentic finance capabilities — positioning new workflows not as features, but as fundamental changes to how their finance team operates

  • Partner with Account Executives and Technical Consulting to deliver seamless implementations and expand Ramp's footprint within accounts

  • Bring customer insight back to Product — surfacing patterns, gaps, and opportunities from your accounts to shape how Ramp evolves

Must-Haves

  • Enterprise change management — You've driven workflow adoption inside complex organizations, navigated real resistance from real stakeholders, and have measurable results to show for it. Finance or fintech context is a plus but not required.

  • AI fluency as a daily habit — You already use AI tools habitually in your work. You use them to prep for calls, synthesize information, build customer-facing materials, and automate repetitive tasks. This is how you work, not something you're exploring. Ramp is a builder culture: if you don't instinctively reach for AI before doing things manually, this role will be a hard adjustment.

  • Financial impact communication — You can walk a CFO through the business case for a workflow change, connect implementation milestones to P&L outcomes, and run executive updates in financial terms, not product terms. A finance background is not required — fluency is.

  • Technical acumen — You can hold your own in conversations with Product and Engineering on integrations, APIs, and workflow architecture. You don't need to code, but credibility in technical conversations is what earns you a seat at the table with the full customer stakeholder group.

  • 7+ years in enterprise customer success or implementations — You’ve spent enough time navigating complex organizations and senior stakeholders that it’s second nature. You know how to move an enterprise, not just support one.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Agentic workflow experience — You've helped customers adopt AI-powered or agentic workflows at scale. You understand what friction looks like in practice and what makes transformation actually stick.

  • Finance domain depth — Exposure to FP&A, accounting software ecosystems (Netsuite, Sage, QuickBooks, Xero), expense management, or CFO-adjacent workflows. Accelerates credibility with Ramp's customer base.

  • Demonstrated commercial impact — You can point to expansion, retention, or time-to-value outcomes with specific metrics attached — not described in general terms.

  • Background at an AI-first or AI transformation company — not just a company that uses AI, but one where rethinking workflows around it was part of the product or culture

  • High-growth or startup experience (comfort operating in ambiguity and rapid change)

  • C-suite relationships built and maintained independently, without relying on a sales counterpart

For candidates located in NYC or SF, the pay range for this role is $198,000- $271,000. For candidates located in all other locations, the pay range for this role is $178,000- $244,000.

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is looking for a Brand Design Recruiter to help build the team behind how our brand shows up in the world. You'll partner with Brand and Creative Studio leaders to define what great looks like for each search, find designers with exceptional visual craft, and guide them through a thoughtful process from first conversation to offer.

You'll need to know creative talent, recognize strong work in a portfolio, and build relationships with people before they're actively looking. You'll bring market insight to hiring conversations, keep searches moving at pace, and give candidates a clear, personal experience throughout.

What You'll Do

  • Own the hiring engine behind Ramp’s brand, bringing in the full-time designers and freelancers who shape how we show up in the world.

  • Find exceptional creative talent where they share their work, from portfolios and design communities to referrals and events.

  • Turn ambitious creative briefs into focused searches, partnering with Brand and Creative Studio leaders to agree what great looks like.

  • Give candidates a fast, personal experience from first conversation through offer and close.

  • Bring creative leaders, hiring managers, Talent and other partners together around priorities, feedback and decisions so searches keep moving.

What You Need

  • 5+ years of recruiting experience, with a strong record of hiring brand or visual design talent.

  • A grasp of creative disciplines from identity and art direction to campaigns, web and motion, and the ability to judge a portfolio beyond the job title.

  • A record of finding and closing designers who were not actively applying, through portfolio research, communities, referrals and tailored outreach.

  • Experience building pipelines for both full-time designers and freelance creative talent, often on different timelines.

  • The ability to keep several searches and stakeholders moving with clear briefs, useful candidate evidence and accurate pipeline data.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for an in-house creative studio, brand team or design agency.

  • Experience building a trusted bench of freelance designers and creative specialists.

  • Experience bringing designers together through events, portfolio reviews or referral programmes.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to research and engage creative talent.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

We are looking for a Legal & Privacy Operations Associate to help the Ramp legal team scale with product and operational leverage as the business grows. You will keep legal requests moving, administer core tools and records, and automate corporate, policy, and privacy program work with Legal and cross-functional partners to accelerate Ramp’s AI products and growth.

What You'll Do

  • Support legal technology and AI workflow improvements, including implementation, training, documentation, and follow-up with vendors and internal partners.

  • Build and maintain privacy program inventories and evidence with Product, Security, IT, and Marketing, including application and third-party vendor records, AI-system use cases, data flows, and records of processing, and follow-up on identified gaps.

  • Support data subject request response and automation.

  • Administer legal systems, including Ironclad, the legal helpdesk, and other internally built systems and knowledge management resources.

  • Execute corporate governance and equity initiatives by managing requirements, and administer policy and control refreshes.

What You Need

  • 1–3 years of experience in legal operations, privacy operations, as a legal assistant or paralegal, or in a comparable role.

  • Demonstrated experience of streamlining legal processes and coordinating contract or data privacy systems.

  • High level of experience managing various operational challenges with ease.

  • Track record as a strong partner for key business leaders, with great communication, organization, and time management skills.

  • Expertise building AI agents and workflows.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Coding experience (Javascript, Python, SQL).

  • Experience administering Ironclad, Ethyca, SimpleLegal, or other legal and privacy technologies.

  • Knowledge of privacy and data protection laws (e.g. CCPA or GDPR).

  • Prior experience in high-growth startups and/or high-growth technology companies.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Every approval request, receipt reminder, payment alert, and card notification Ramp sends has to reach the right person, on the right channel, at the right time. When it does, finance teams close faster and employees spend less time chasing tasks. When it doesn't, a missed message can mean a stalled approval, a late payment, or a flood of notifications nobody asked for.

Ramp's Communications Platform team builds the shared system that every product team uses to reach customers. It handles transactional messages across email, SMS, push, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp, including templating, delivery, retries, digesting, user preferences, and delivery monitoring. The team also supports the conversational experiences that let customers work with Ramp directly from the channels they already use.

We're looking for a backend engineer to own a core part of that platform. You'll take responsibility for an area such as message delivery and channel integrations, communication preferences, or platform reliability and scale, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it correct and dependable as message volume and the number of teams building on it grow. You'll work closely with product, design, and engineering partners across Ramp to make communications faster, more reliable, and easier for every team to build on.

What You'll Do

  • Own the design and evolution of a core part of Ramp's communications platform, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

  • Build and extend integrations with messaging channels and delivery providers, including email, SMS, push, and workplace chat tools such as Slack and Microsoft Teams

  • Design delivery workflows that are idempotent, retry safely, and confirm successful delivery, so customers reliably get the messages they need without duplicate sends

  • Build communication preferences and controls that let users and administrators decide what they receive and where

  • Make the platform simple and safe for other Ramp engineers to build on, with clear abstractions, strong defaults, and good developer tooling

  • Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of the platform as message volume grows

  • Drive technical direction for your area and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship

What You'll Need

  • Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

  • A track record of owning a system or product area end to end and shaping its technical direction over time

  • Strong system design judgment, especially around reliability, idempotency, and correctness in high-volume distributed systems

  • Product sense: you care about the experience of the people receiving each message, not just the ticket, and you balance speed with quality

  • Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions across product, design, and engineering

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building notification, messaging, or communications platforms

  • Experience integrating with messaging providers or channel APIs, such as Twilio, SendGrid, Slack, Microsoft Teams, or WhatsApp

  • Experience building internal platforms or shared services used by many engineering teams

  • Experience scaling high-volume, event-driven, or queue-based systems

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices
